a.lede: Walmart has MSI's GeForce RTX 5090 Gaming Trio for just $4299 as part of its GeForce Week event, a rare deal on the most powerful graphics card around as the AI boom drives prices ever higher.
a.title: Get this spiffy, stealthy MSI Gaming Trio RTX 5090 for just $4,299

b.lede: CyberPowerPC is offering five different pre-built gaming PCs with either an RTX 5070, 5080, or 5090 Founders Edition GPUs paired with either an Intel or AMD X3D CPU. They also come with 32GB of DDR5 RAM and 1TB of NVMe SSD, all for reasonable prices.
b.title: CyberPowerPC lands rare RTX 50-series Founders Edition cards in discounted Walmart rigs
